notes.title: Timing and rhythm
notes.summary: Check alignment at the start, middle and end. Preserve intentional syncopation; correct source alignment before shifting notes.

notes.title: Musical emphasis
notes.summary: Let movement reflect the sound: doubles, space and wider strokes should have an audible reason.

notes.title: Parity and recovery
notes.summary: Inspect each hand's entry and exit. Rapid repeated cuts merit review, but a reset after a rest can be deliberate.

notes.title: Repetition with variation
notes.summary: Recurring music can retain a recognizable phrase while changed instrumentation motivates a different accent or exit.

notes.title: Visibility and jumps
notes.summary: Consider clutter, jump settings and neighboring patterns together. A warning remains a hypothesis until reviewed.

notes.title: Functional lighting
notes.summary: Keep the environment readable and mark structure. A playable map does not require rich animation.

notes.title: Technical intent
notes.summary: Unusual movement is not automatically defective. Record setup, readability, intent and recovery before revising it.
